proposed.explanation: The four UNESCO World Heritage Baroque churches (1993): (1) San Agustin Church, Manila — oldest surviving stone church (completed 1607); (2) San Agustin Church, Paoay — PRIMARY Earthquake Baroque with 14 massive buttresses; (3) Nuestra Señora de la Asunción, Santa Maria — hilltop fortress-like appearance; (4) Santo Tomás de Villanueva, Miagao — 'Fortress Baroque' with tropical facade showing St. Christopher with coconut palms and papaya.
